thresholds.advice: The typical cell is far from square. Check that the radial count is in proportion to the azimuthal one — an O-grid with 96 points round the body and 12 out to the far field stretches every cell the same way.

The worst cell is in the wall band and its ratio is the azimuthal spacing over BL_INITIAL_THICKNESS. Either ask for a less aggressive first cell or put more points round the body; this number is arithmetic, not a defect to smooth away.
The cells away from the wall band are stretched. Spread the radial spacing law out: a growth rate that reaches its final interval early leaves the outer rows long and thin.
